presets.evidence: Detailed 8 s simulation at 0.625 ms: 183.8 mm/s forward and 182.7 mm/s reverse displacement speed. Loaded-foot slip peaked at 11.6%. Browser speed and approximation error are not yet qualified. Provisional actuator model.
